system: You are a bounded JavaScript module worker. No tools, network, secrets, personal data, or deployment. Return only JavaScript source without markdown. Root integrates and tests. Do not modify existing files. Do not create a new profile protocol, parser, router or storage system.
prompt: Implement a small browser-safe ES module for a professional-network app. Export CHATGPT_PROFILE_PROMPT and summarizeTransfer(profile). Import normalizeBrief, CAPABILITIES, CITIES, LANGUAGES, MODES from './profile-brief.mjs'. They are existing stable local exports: normalizeBrief returns goal (240 chars), offer_tags, need_tags, languages, modes, city_code, max_km (0/25/50/100/300), remote, available_from/available_until YYYY-MM-DD or empty, confidentiality, accepts_confidentiality, version:1. CAPABILITIES keys automation/design/research/sales/video/finance/events map to Ukrainian labels. LANGUAGES uk/en/de/fr, MODES exchange/joint_project, CITIES zurich/winterthur/zug/basel/bern map to {label,...}. Prompt must be Ukrainian, for pasting by a user into their OWN ChatGPT. Request only supported facts about themselves actually available through current chat, saved memories or referenced past chats. Explicitly do not imply complete history access; never invent facts from missing memory. Output only existing synera-profile-2 JSON {format:'synera-profile-2',profile:{display_name,city,offers,seeks,is_discoverable:false,map_visible:false,brief:{...}}}. Four text maxima 60/80/300/300. Unknown strings empty and lists empty; no invented current availability dates, travel willingness or legal promises; set all privacy/permission flags false. Map only evidence-backed professional capabilities, language skill, goal. Never include email/phone/address/credentials, health, finances, family, diary, third-party personal facts or raw conversations. Do not output sample filler as real facts. All values may be reviewed before save. summarizeTransfer returns an array of {label,value} Ukrainian display rows for goal, offered/needed tags, languages, modes, city-or-remote, availability. Unknown rows show 'Не вказано'; safe known-map lookup only, input normalized with normalizeBrief. No DOM, clipboard, fetch, storage, auto-saving or model API.

system: You are the independent cross-family UX and security reviewer. Bounded public product spec only. No tools, private data or credentials. Return <=650 words, concrete failure cases and acceptance gates. Do not invent supported OpenAI APIs or call anything production-ready.
prompt: Review an implementation plan for Synera, a vanilla JavaScript PWA with authenticated profile storage. User wants years of their consumer ChatGPT memory transferred without manually filling every field. Official-source boundary confirmed: there is no documented consumer memory/history OAuth scope or retrieval API; Apps SDK authenticates Synera accounts and tools receive explicit selected payloads; tools must not pull or reconstruct a full chat log. No supported chatgpt.com prefilled-prompt deep-link contract. Immediate plan: a prominent 'Заповнити з ChatGPT' button opens a three-step guided dialog; copy a nonpersonal instruction and open https://chatgpt.com in a new tab; user pastes prompt in their own ordinary ChatGPT (where their available memory/context may be used), copies the resulting existing synera-profile-2 JSON; paste in Synera; local parser strips unknown fields, blocks obvious contacts/secrets, forces profile/map visibility false; editable four profile fields plus visible summary of imported goal/tags/languages/conditions; explicit apply-to-form then ordinary save. No credentials collected, no ChatGPT cookies/session scraping, no whole-export ZIP upload, no AI request on the app server, no URL-encoded personal profile, no clipboard reads without a click, no overwrite/save until review. Existing importer already normalizes full v2 brief but its old ChatGPT prompt only requested v1/current-chat facts. Address missing memory, stale inferred dates, incorrect tags, pasted prompt injection, unauthorized imports, stale preview after input/consent changes, user existing unsaved form, inaccessible clipboard/popups/mobile, and false free-token claims. API data-sharing free allocation is account-specific, may bill an over-limit request in full, and does not unlock consumer Memory. Give prioritized fixes plus meaningful tests; avoid suggesting a new universal agent platform, profile database or parser.
